title: Billions in art sit in a warehouse nobody visits
description: Freeports are storage buildings beside airports where art is legally in transit and therefore untaxed. Works enter, change owners, and leave decades later without ever being unwrapped.

scenes.narration: Billions of dollars of art sit in a warehouse that nobody visits.
scenes.imagePrompt: Rows of tall wooden shipping crates stacked in a dim windowless warehouse, deep one-point perspective down the aisle, a single overhead lamp, plain unmarked timber, no people

scenes.narration: They are called freeports. Most of them sit beside an airport.
scenes.imagePrompt: Exterior of a plain grey windowless warehouse at dusk beside an empty perimeter fence, faint runway lights far behind it, overcast sky, no signage, no people

scenes.narration: One in Switzerland is believed to hold more than a million works.
scenes.imagePrompt: Narrow aisle between towering steel storage racks holding flat wrapped packages, cold even light fading into darkness at the far end, plain grey wrapping, no people

scenes.narration: The contents of that single building have been estimated at a hundred billion dollars.
scenes.imagePrompt: A single large painting crate standing upright under one work lamp in a dark concrete room, plain unmarked timber, deep shadow filling the space around it

scenes.narration: While the art is inside, it counts as in transit. No import duty, no sales tax.
scenes.imagePrompt: Heavy steel security door with a small keypad in a dim concrete corridor, cold light raking from one side, deep shadow, no signage, no markings

scenes.narration: A painting can change owners repeatedly without ever leaving the room.
scenes.imagePrompt: Two gloved hands lifting the corner of grey protective wrapping from a framed canvas, only the plain gilt frame edge visible, warm task lamp, dark room, no faces

scenes.narration: It is not hung, not lit, and most of it is never unwrapped.
scenes.imagePrompt: A framed canvas turned to face the wall in a dim storage room, only its wooden stretcher bars and bare canvas back visible, single raking light, deep shadow

scenes.narration: The value was never in looking at it. It was in where it sits.
scenes.imagePrompt: Wide view down an unlit warehouse aisle full of wrapped artworks receding into total blackness, one distant lamp at the far end, no people
